get_face_enhancer: get a GFPGAN ONNX Runtime inference session with optimized CUDA and CoreML providers
enhance_face: enhance all detected faces in a video frame using GFPGAN with affine alignment and feathered blending
process_frame: process a video frame to enhance faces, optionally using a source face reference
process_image: process a single image file to enhance all detected faces and save the result
process_video: process all frames of a video to enhance detected faces using batched frame processing
